enchantment.extraenchants.volley.desc: Bow fires 2 extra arrows per level in a fan.
enchantment.extraenchants.ore_wisdom.des: Ores give much more experience; iron, gold and copper ores give some too.
Killed mobs drop +50% experience per level.
enchantment.extraenchants.telekinesis.de: Mined drops go straight into your inventory.
enchantment.extraenchants.lifesteal.desc: Heals you for 10% of melee damage dealt per level.
enchantment.extraenchants.beheading.desc: 5% chance per level for mobs and players to drop their head.
enchantment.extraenchants.frost_aspect.d: Hit targets are frozen and slowed.
